subject: Renewal & capacity add — procurement portal steps and PO coordination
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@heliomed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity add — procurement portal steps and PO coordination

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, Helio Med is planning to renew the existing Redwood agreement and add capacity for the Q4 launch (roughly +35% token commitment). To keep timelines tight on your side I want to confirm the procurement steps we expect: 

1) We deliver an updated SOW + pricing sheet for the term change and capacity ramp.
2) You submit an official PO via your procurement portal (we can accept email PO if portal timing is slow).
3) DocuSign signature and effective date scheduled after PO receipt.

I attached a draft SOW and pricing worksheet for your review. Can you confirm who in procurement will create the PO and whether the portal requires any vendor onboarding fields (tax ID, W9, EDI)? If helpful, we can run an onboarding checklist with your procurement tech contact.

Proposed next steps: 
- Samantha: confirm PO owner + any portal gating fields by EOD Wed (4/4)
- Monica: will produce final SOW version after we get any redline requests from Helio
- Karthik: standing by to confirm compute profile for the extra capacity (no code changes expected)

Thanks — aiming to lock this before your fiscal cutoff on 4/15.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: RI_SOW_Q3_v3.pdf, capacity_pricing_Q3.xlsx

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@heliomed.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@heliomed.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity add — procurement portal steps and PO coordination

Rohan —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Carlos (cc'd) owns PO creation in our portal. A couple items for vendor onboarding I need clarified before he can submit: 
- Redwood legal entity name and vendor tax ID (EIN)
- Standard invoice remit address (we use EFT/ACH)
- Any resale/subcontractor disclosure (no for us?)

Portal note: our procurement portal requires a vendor profile; it will prompt for a W9 and a short supplier questionnaire. Uploads can be done by our procurement team but the form needs the vendor EIN and a banking contact.

I'll loop Carlos and he can confirm the timing. We should be able to submit PO within 3 business days of receiving the final SOW and vendor EIN.

Samantha Lee
Procurement Manager | Helio Med
samantha.lee@heliomed.com
+1 617-555-4402

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@heliomed.com>, Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@heliomed.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Updated SOW and quick vendor checklist (attached)

Hi Samantha & Carlos —

Attached is RI_SOW_Q3_v3.pdf with the term change (12 months), capacity uplift (+35% committed), and an optional burst lane. I also included a short vendor onboarding checklist in the body of the PDF covering EIN, W9, remit, and a primary AR contact to place on the vendor profile.

Quick summary of changes from the current agreement: 
- Term adjusted to 2028-04-16 through 2029-04-15
- Committed tokens +35% (monthly commitment lane)
- Price per 1M tokens adjusted based on the volume tier (see capacity_pricing_Q3.xlsx)

Can you confirm if Helio requires a specific PO number format? We can mirror your internal numbering in the invoice. If you prefer, I can also upload the vendor files into your portal — just provide a procurement upload link or invite.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 650-555-2233

Attachments: RI_SOW_Q3_v3.pdf, capacity_pricing_Q3.xlsx

From: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@heliomed.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@heliomed.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Updated SOW and quick vendor checklist (attached)

Monica / Samantha —

Thanks for the SOW. Portal notes: you can either (A) have Redwood create a new supplier profile in our portal (we will send an invite to the AR email) or (B) we can email a PO to accounts-payable@redwood.com once the internal approvers sign off. Option A is preferred for tracking. 

I attached the PO PDF draft (PO_4521_HelioMed.pdf) — it references your SOW and includes our internal cost center. Two small asks before finalizing: 
- Please confirm Redwood's EIN (send W9)
- Confirm the invoice remit email and preferred ACH info (or confirm paper check)

Once those are received I will route the PO for approval. Expect a DocuSign envelope after approval (I will share the tracking link).

Carlos Mendoza
Senior Procurement Specialist | Helio Med
c.mendoza@heliomed.com
+1 617-555-3321

Attachment: PO_4521_HelioMed.pdf

Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated SOW and quick vendor checklist (attached)

Carlos / Samantha —

Attached W9 and Redwood vendor EIN: 38-2345678. AR contact for portal invite: ar@redwood.com (accounts receivable team). We accept ACH. Monica has uploaded the final SOW to our shared drive and I confirmed the pricing workbook matches the PO draft.

Next steps on our side: 
- Monica will accept the portal invite and confirm the supplier profile details once received.
- I will watch for the DocuSign envelope and confirm effective date.
- Karthik will schedule a short kickoff to validate capacity profile once PO is fully executed.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out so you have the additional capacity for the Q4 launch.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
